title: Partition polynomial
statement: Let $p:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, $z\in\{−1,1\}^n$, and $\pi:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$. The partition polynomial is the multilinear polynomial on $\{−1,1\}^m$ whose coefficient at each set $T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ is $\sum_{S:\,J_\pi(S)=T}\widehat p(S)\,\chi_S(z)$, with $J_\pi(S)$ the odd-multiplicity image set under $\pi$.
